title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The literal suggestion candidate previously passed focused validation, but pristine upstream remains unvalidated. A prior restore attempt has an unknown result after a private wrapper failed to retain its child process identifier; a subsequent read-only check found no such process running. The source-only isolated offline restore plan now pins the package archives, NuGet tool and configuration, eight manifests, native root-import hashes, Runner assets, and vcpkg inputs. The three required pristine root imports remain absent, so an assigned restore sequence and a passing import guard are prerequisites to any build. No validation ran during this plan update. Round 3 was Lite, not full agentic review, and its remaining thread concerns a review-introduced test seam, not an upstream defect. No convergence or author-facing action is claimed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
